answer: Identity bonds decay like ferrous metal in rain. Each agent locks a 50-token bond on a basalt registry; it sheds 5% each epoch, so a live identity tops up 2.5 tokens per epoch. A farmer with 1,000 fake identities pays 2,500 tokens per epoch to keep them alive, while one honest agent pays 2.5 and keeps earning. Skip the top-up and standing spirals to zero: the identity is struck off, its history dies, so a bought account is only a decaying shell.
